title: Add Production checklist + linting for env var docs and example freshness
author: Wei Chen
release_notes: Quickstarts now include a Production checklist and CI linting to keep env var docs and runnable examples from drifting.
body: Summary: This adds a repo-level "Production checklist" doc intended to be the last stop before a user deploys a template to a managed environment. It also adds lightweight automated checks to reduce doc/code drift: (1) env var documentation lint that validates every required env var is documented and that docs match the template .env.example files, and (2) example freshness checks to ensure docs snippets that claim to be runnable remain aligned with the current template entrypoints (prevents broken quickstart commands from living in the README). Motivation: Support and dogfooding feedback flagged recurring issues where users miss timeouts/retries/config, or follow outdated env var instructions after refactors. This PR makes those problems harder to ship by adding a clear checklist and gating checks in CI. Scope/details: - New doc: docs/PRODUCTION_CHECKLIST.md (applies across templates; links out to per-template knobs) - New doc: docs/ENV_VARS.md (single place to explain env var conventions: required vs optional, defaulting behavior, precedence, and security notes) - New CI job: quickstart-lint (runs on PRs) - New script: tools/lint_env_docs.py (compares docs vs discovered vars from templates/*/.env.example; enforces required vars documented; enforces consistent naming; flags deprecated vars) - New script: tools/check_example_commands.sh (verifies documented "make run"/"docker compose"/"uvicorn" commands exist for each template, and that referenced paths still exist) - Added a small "Docs hygiene" section to CONTRIBUTING.md and a pre-commit hook suggestion (optional). Behavior: - The env var linter treats vars in .env.example as the canonical source of truth. If a template adds a new required env var and forgets to document it, CI fails with an actionable error message. - Optional vars must be documented OR explicitly allow-listed in docs/env-vars.allowlist.txt (keeps CI strict while allowing experimentation flags without forcing full docs immediately). - Example freshness checks are intentionally shallow (existence checks + command target checks) to avoid requiring GPUs in CI. Follow-ups (not included): - Expand example checks to run one request against staging in nightly (already covered by smoke tests PR). - Add a docs-site snippet extractor check once docs integration lands (ENG-2850). Files/areas changed (high level): - docs/PRODUCTION_CHECKLIST.md - docs/ENV_VARS.md - docs/env-vars.allowlist.txt - tools/lint_env_docs.py - tools/check_example_commands.sh - .github/workflows/lint.yml - templates/rag-python/README.md (links to checklist; minor wording) - templates/agents-ts/README.md (links to checklist; minor wording) - CONTRIBUTING.md (docs hygiene section) Example linter output (new): lint-env-vars :: ERROR: templates/rag-python/.env.example defines REDWOOD_REQUEST_TIMEOUT_MS but docs/ENV_VARS.md does not mention it. Hint: add to Required vars or add to allowlist if experimental. lint-env-vars :: ERROR: docs says REDWOOD_API_KEY is optional, but .env.example marks it as required. Commits: 1) docs: add Production checklist covering telemetry, retries, rollout safety 2) docs: add ENV_VARS conventions and precedence 3) ci: add quickstart-lint workflow job 4) tooling: env var docs linter + allowlist support 5) tooling: example command freshness check + README link updates Review conversation (abridged): - Elliot Price (Docs): "Checklist reads well, but can we be explicit about what 'production-ready' means vs template defaults? Also, I want a single place to explain env var precedence (shell vs .env vs compose)." - Wei Chen: "Updated checklist intro with 'baseline safe defaults, not a guarantee' language + added precedence section to ENV_VARS.md (shell > .env > defaults; compose reads from .env by default)." - Sean Gallagher (SRE): "Please avoid noisy/over-prescriptive alert thresholds in the checklist. Also call out graceful shutdown + request timeouts explicitly." - Wei Chen: "Adjusted to point to Observability Pack for thresholds and added explicit bullets for shutdown hooks + timeouts + 429 backoff." - Marcus Lin (Security): "Two concerns: (1) checklist mentions logging request/tenant ids—ensure we warn against logging prompts/PII by default. (2) env var docs should recommend secret managers and discourage committing .env." - Wei Chen: "Added 'Never log prompts or raw tool outputs by default' callout + linked to secrets/local dev policy. Added explicit 'do not commit .env' and secret manager guidance (KMS/Secrets Manager/1Password)." - Dana Lo (TS templates): "Env var linter failing on commented-out examples in .env.example—can it ignore commented lines?" - Wei Chen: "Fixed parser to ignore lines starting with # and inline comments; added unit test fixture." Requested changes addressed: - Add allowlist file for experimental/advanced vars - Parser fix for comments in .env.example - Checklist language tightened to avoid prescribing exact alert thresholds - Add security logging guidance CI status: - quickstart-lint (env var docs): PASS - quickstart-lint (example commands): PASS - unit (python tools): PASS - markdown lint: PASS Merge: Squash merged by Wei Chen after approvals from Elliot Price and Sean Gallagher.
